title: I-81 corridor UFO flaps
place_text: Norfolk/Langley to Winchester, I-81 to Harrisburg PA, DC, Pax River

tellings.quote: towards Pax River. Uh it's called the I81 corridor and they had historically UFO flaps. I hate to call them that for years, decades.

plain: A guest named Dylan Borland says that a stretch of the eastern US, from Norfolk and Langley up to Winchester, along Interstate 81 to Harrisburg in Pennsylvania, and around Washington and Pax River, a Navy air base in Maryland, has had UFO "flaps", waves of sightings, for decades. He calls it the I-81 corridor and mentions it alongside the TV show Unsolved Mysteries and the writer Michael Shermer, without naming a firmer source. The area is thick with military bases, which is why the pattern interests him.
